shared_assumption_model.scope: The independent West Guanting shares the East Guanting candidate assumptions of three facade divisions, a central closed double door, two lattice windows, a simple single-ridge two-slope roof, approximate colours and plain rear closure. West Guanting uses its own documented dimensions and revised base, wall and roof envelopes; it is not an equal-size mirrored copy. Shared assumptions do not establish matching real bay counts, doors, windows, roof types or colours. No unsupported details are added to distinguish the candidates.
